edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving Confidential Information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction, protect it with reasonable care, and disclose it only to representatives who need to know it for that purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations. The receiving party is responsible for its representatives’ breaches of this Agreement. These obligations continue for three years after disclosure; provided that Confidential Information qualifying as a trade secret remains protected for so long as it qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law. Confidential Information does not include information the receiving party can demonstrate was publicly available without its breach, already lawfully known to it, independently developed without use of the disclosed information, or lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality. If legally compelled to disclose Confidential Information, the receiving party shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, promptly notify the disclosing party before disclosure and reasonably cooperate, at the disclosing party’s expense, with efforts to seek protection. The receiving party shall disclose only the portion legally required. Upon the disclosing party’s written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy its Confidential Information, except that it may retain copies required by law or bona fide record-retention policies and copies held in routine backup systems, provided retained information remains subject to this Agreement and is not used for any other purpose.

delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving Confidential Information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction, protect it with reasonable care, and disclose it only to representatives who need to know it for that purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations. These obligations continue for three years after disclosure. Confidential Information does not include information the receiving party can demonstrate was publicly available without its breach, already lawfully known to it, independently developed without use of the disclosed information, or lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
